properties.description: Built 2026-10-23 in PR A1 "proofs and arguments read right" (dec:idea-a-bridge-premise-says-a-formal-statement-models-a-claim, option b). statement_kind `bridge` on a Requirement or Constraint. Its own truth holds, carried as a BRIDGE (a fourth condition beside assumptions, unverified citations and tests, `Condition.bridges` in inference.rs), so what rests on it reads `conditional` (claim `rests_on_bridges`, step `rests_on_bridges` and `holds_as: conditional`, proof_status conditional "only as far as the bridge(s) model what they are taken to model"); statement_reading reads `bridge`. It is an ordinary premise, never an assumed one, so an objection aimed at it reaches it and contests every claim resting on it, while the theorem under it stands. reasoning_report lists `bridges` apart from `stated_foundations`, `uncited_premises` and unverified citations; propagate_from rows name `bridges_lost`. A bridge argued for by a step still carries itself. The missing-bridge check (option c) is not built.
properties.name: A bridge premise (statement_kind bridge) says a formal statement models another field's claim: what rests on it reads conditional on it, an objection to it contests every claim resting on it, and the read-back lists it apart from citations and foundations
